_metadata.description: Durable private workspace, on-boarding draft, dietary rules, kitchen capabilities, and priority weights.

requirements.title: User-owned records belong to a server-authorized workspace
requirements.description: The scenario shall scope every user-owned aggregate to a server-authorized private workspace, deriving the actor and accessible scope from the authenticated session rather than any client-supplied owner identifier.

validation.notes: Planned: domain store rejects an aggregate created without a workspace; a workspace-scoped query never returns another workspace's rows. Cross-workspace reads, writes, downloads, and nested foreign references are denied (ACT-036).
Planned: a generated API client cannot read or mutate a foreign workspace even when it supplies that owner ID.

requirements.title: Saved edits survive refresh and new sessions
requirements.description: When a saved edit is committed, the scenario shall persist it durably so that a refresh, a new session, or another authorized device reloads the same records rather than resetting to demo seed data.

validation.notes: Planned: save a profile edit, restart the API and reload the UI, and observe the same record; a failed save visibly retains the local draft (ACT-034).

requirements.title: Fixtures are never silently adopted as real data
requirements.description: The scenario shall keep development fixtures and anonymous exploration deliberately isolated from authenticated accounts, so sample food content can never be presented or persisted as the user's own records.

validation.notes: Planned: a fresh real account starts with an intentional empty state, not a demo profile (ACT-001); loading or error states never render sample numbers as saved facts (ACT-022).

requirements.title: Four-step setup is a resumable draft
requirements.description: The setup experience shall present the four steps Your food, Your kitchen, Your rhythm, and Ready, keep all edits as a draft until the final apply, and preserve entered values across Back, Continue, refresh, and resume.

validation.notes: Planned: draft state machine preserves values across navigation and never mutates active rules before apply (ACT-002).
Planned UI journey: leave setup mid-step, reopen, and confirm the resumable draft with Keep editing / Discard behavior.

requirements.title: Diet presets compile to explicit, versioned rules
requirements.description: The scenario shall compile data-driven diet presets into explicit active rules, keep composable exclusions separate from the preset, and record the preset version plus expanded rules so a later preset update cannot silently change the user's contract.

validation.notes: Planned: switching vegan/vegetarian/pescatarian/everything/plant-forward/my-own-way yields the documented rules while independent restrictions survive (ACT-003).
Planned: a restriction whose evidence is unresolved raises Needs information rather than passing (ACT-004).

requirements.title: Kitchen capabilities and priorities are stable inputs
requirements.description: The scenario shall store appliances as stable capabilities rather than display text, accept zero appliances, and map ordinary-language priority answers to editable cost, effort, and variety weights while preserving a persisted custom vector after reload.

validation.notes: Planned: answer-to-weight mapping matches the documented table and a custom vector reopens as Custom, not a quantized preset (ACT-005, ACT-006).
Planned UI journey: select zero appliances and confirm ready-to-eat assembly meals are still offered.

requirements.title: Apply previews conflicts and counts eligibility truthfully
requirements.description: When a profile is applied, the scenario shall preview conflicts against any existing plan, count matching meals through the same eligibility service the planner uses, and never relax a restriction merely to produce a nonzero count.

validation.notes: Planned: applying a new restriction flags affected future locks while historical intake is unchanged (ACT-007); no-eligible-meals shows a rule-conflict summary with a repair path.
Planned UI journey: review and apply an edited setup and confirm the previewed count matches planner eligibility.
